paper.role: Ground. Page and card background in light mode.

ink.role: Text, primary buttons, the mark. Ground in dark mode.

coral.role: The accent. The five-day window in the mark, the one key action per screen, deadlines, REPORTABLE, cost-of-failure numbers. Never for body text.

slate.role: Secondary text, captions, sources, placeholders (light mode).

stone.role: Lines, dividers, disabled fills, ring track (light mode).

stone-light.role: Secondary button hover, table stripes, subtle panels (light mode).
